title: P1 grant.request: request
description: An attempt's request for a grant of a stronger model (the built-in tool request_model_grant, a job worker through P1 grant.request) with a closed justification; one request per task. After the request the attempt ends without being spent with awaiting_model_grant (MGR-17, docs/farm-manager.md). The lease token goes in the Botaru-Lease header.

reason.description: Why the attempt asks for a stronger model; code checks the reasons of its own attempts from evidence against it.

evidence.description: Its own attempts of this task.

requested_profile.description: Model profile from the role's ladder ∩ profiles allowed to the tenant; never a seat profile.

attempts.description: How many attempts on the strong model the executor asks for.

note.description: Untrusted note; the farm manager does not see it.
